correctness.rationale: The derivation rule produces D(e_j)=ja_1 e_j+sum_{r≥2}a_r e_{j+r−1}, determining q^n maps. When a_1=0, first nonzero higher coefficient determines kernel by its shift order. When a_1≠0, restriction to span(e_2,...,e_n) is E+M_f on truncated polynomials. Characteristic-p gauge elimination leaves zero residues only at t^{kp}; Jacobson identity (E+M_f)^p−(E+M_f)=M_{sum_h(f_h^p−f_{ph})t^{ph}} and the first nonzero resonance control nullity. Conditional successive resonance equations each determine a later independent coefficient, giving exact counts even over nonprime F_q. Boundaries z=0 and z=1 agree. Independent check: Independent exact modular rank enumeration of the derivation matrices for 12 cases over prime fields p=2,3,5, including p=2,n=6 histogram (0,32,16,12,2,1,1), matched every formula count. No general derivation-algebra theorem was inferred from enumeration; proof handles finite nonprime fields through Frobenius bijectivity.
